domain_errors.meaning: archived master cannot receive a new active operational relationship or ordinary edit requiring active state
one or more active dependencies would be stranded; no archival mutation or receipt committed; detailed blockers are obtained through bounded read-only preview
archive/reactivation eligibility could not be proven because an owning-domain dependency guard failed or was indeterminate; command failed closed
current constraints prevent reactivation; archived history remains unchanged
requested current affiliation requires an active Customer Organization
normalized Customer Account Code already has one or more different active Customer claimants; ordinary assignment does not steal, merge, or silently add another claimant
reviewed account-code reassignment expected the source Customer to hold an active claim but authoritative state no longer agrees
shared-claim command lacks valid reviewed conflict context or no longer represents an actual multi-claim conflict
the exact claimant/target/source state bound to the reviewed conflict snapshot changed before commit; no receipt or domain mutation occurred
database matching profile is not supported by this application build; matching reads/writes are blocked rather than reinterpreted
Contact channel fails its closed storage policy; value is not persisted or truncated
recipient-dependent action has no selected active channel usable for the requested purpose; underlying Contact and operational record remain valid
requested channel does not belong to the identified Contact
setting key is absent from the closed SettingDefinition registry
persisted/requested setting contract/version cannot be interpreted under the current registered definition
secret-classified material cannot be persisted in ordinary setting_values
installation already has its one Local User Profile identity
candidate key is blank/invalid after governed normalization or scope is malformed
semantic field/collection exceeds its field-specific accepted bound; value was not truncated

rule: Ambiguity, source-account-code conflict evidence, recipient prerequisite failure, semantic no-change and affiliation mismatch do not invalidate unrelated domain entities and may not be converted into guessed identity mutation.
